## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the white desk fan with the right arm and position it on the Maroon mat facing the robot.

Task description: Use the right arm to place the white tabletop fan at the front center of the table on the maroon square mat to the right, with the fan face toward the robot.

Success criteria: The fan is placed near the center of the maroon mat, with its base on the mat and body upright, fan face toward the robot. The fan has been released and both grippers remain open.

## Execution tips

- For the right gripper, choose a region on the upper base or solid housing behind the fan grille that both fingers can surround. Prefer relatively flat contact surfaces, avoiding the grille, rounded ends, and adjustment seams, and leave placement clearance beneath the base.
- Match the gripper opening to the width of the selected section and nearby clearance. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of that section to avoid merely overlapping in the image while pushing the fan.
- When turning it, leave room for the circular fan guard's outer edge to rotate. Watch the shoe behind it and the shovel at the rear right to avoid sweeping into nearby objects during wrist rotation.
- During placement, release only after the base rests flat on the mat and the body is no longer tilted. Withdraw in a direction clear of the fan to avoid releasing it while suspended or knocking it over.
